{{Quote|The Empire hurt people close to me. Family. Friends. A girl I loved, once.|Wedge Antilles, talking about how the Empire harmed Mala|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
'''Mala'''<ref name="Helmet Collection">{{HelmetCollectionCite|57|Highlights of the Saga}}</ref> was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Aftermath" /> individual who was beloved to [[Wedge Antilles]]. At some point during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Mala, along with [[Antilles family|Antilles' family]], were harmed by the Empire.<ref name="Aftermath" /><ref name="Helmet Collection" /> During his [[time]] with [[Phoenix Squadron]], Antilles wore a [[flight helmet]] bearing the name of Mala in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="Warhead">{{Rebels|Warhead (episode)}}</ref><ref name="ITNOTR">{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mala was first indirectly mentioned in [[Chuck Wendig]]'s [[2015]] novel [[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']].<ref name="Aftermath" /> She was first named on Wedge Antilles' flight [[helmet]] in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Warhead]],"<ref name="Warhead" /> which aired on [[January 14]], [[2017]].<ref name="Screener">{{WebCite|url=http://tvlistings.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels-warhead/EP018796240070?aid=zap2it|text=Star Wars Rebels : ''Warhead''|date=2016-12-12|work=[http://tvlistings.zap2it.com Screener]|archivedate=20170107080527}}</ref> Mala was not identified as a separate character until the release of the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 57|fifty-seventh]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine in [[2018]].<ref name="Helmet Collection" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the character of [[Mala Tinero]] first appeared through flashbacks in "[[Lucky (comic story)|Lucky]]," a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Rob Williams]] and penciled by [[Michel Lacombe]]. It was published in the [[Star Wars Tales 23|twenty-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' series<ref name="Lucky">{{Tales|23|Lucky (comic story)}}</ref> on [[May 11]], [[2005]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54696/star_wars_tales_1999_23|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #23}}</ref> Her last name of Tinero was identified in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', penned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
